methodology_note: Study units derived from Toronto Notes SOURCE STRUCTURE (toc_inventory.json), cross-checked against body-page OCR (derived/toronto-notes-2025/ocr/pages/) per the documented source-recovery protocol. Emergency Medicine's TOC page (pdf 247) is a two-column layout whose OCR interleaved adjacent-column text onto single lines; nearly all of the chapter's 45 level-3 topic nodes therefore carry titles that concatenate two unrelated real headings (documented individually in same_page_merge_resolutions below). A separate, unrelated defect was found in the section-boundary page numbers themselves: for the contiguous run of nodes ER.S05-ER.S08 (Otolaryngological, Gynecologic, Ophthalmologic, Dermatologic), each node's recorded start_pdf_page is one page earlier than where its titled content actually begins in the body OCR (documented in section_boundary_lag below); node titles remain the correct structural match despite the page-number offset. ER.S09.T06 has no corresponding real content anywhere in this chapter's body pages and is treated as a running-header OCR artifact - see excluded_artifact_nodes. A targeted 2026-08-25 follow-up resolved the three previously-unresolved TOC fragments 'opine...Spinal Cord Trauma' / 'Joint Pain' / 'Shortness of Breath': 'Spinal Cord Trauma' is genuine ER content that had no study unit (added as SU-ER-53); 'Joint Pain' and 'Shortness of Breath' are genuine body subheadings but are cross-reference-only stubs pointing to other chapters (Rheumatology, Respirology/Cardiology) with no ER-specific content, so no study units were added for them. See same_page_merge_resolutions for ER.S11/S13/S14 for full detail.

section_boundary_lag: For nodes ER.S05 through ER.S08 (pdf 285-290 per toc_inventory.json), body-heading confirmation shows each node's recorded start_pdf_page/end_pdf_page is one page earlier than where its titled real content actually begins: ER.S04's Stroke/TIA topic (T12) actually starts on pdf 285, inside ER.S05's stated range (SU-ER-28); Epistaxis (ER.S05.T01) actually starts on pdf 286, inside ER.S06's stated range (SU-ER-29); Nephrolithiasis (ER.S06.T03) actually starts on pdf 288, inside ER.S07's stated range (SU-ER-31); Ophthalmologic content actually starts on pdf 289, inside ER.S08's stated range (SU-ER-32); Dermatologic content is a single real page at pdf 290 against a stated 289-290 range (SU-ER-33). No lag was found before pdf 285 or after pdf 290 - the boundary is self-correcting by ER.S09 (pdf 291). Study units in this range cite the node id that is the correct title match and record the true confirmed pdf_page_range; the discrepancy is noted per-unit and summarized once here rather than repeated in full each time.
